title: Global sections of a constant etale sheaf on a connected scheme
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] whose underlying topological space is connected (in particular nonempty) [def-weil-connected-scheme], let $E$ be an abelian group, and let $\underline E$ be the constant sheaf with value $E$ on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], i.e. the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] of the constant presheaf $U\mapsto E$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], an object of $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]; write $\iota_T:E\to\underline E(T)$ for the component at the final object $T$ of the canonical map from the constant presheaf to its sheafification. Then $\iota_T$ is an isomorphism of abelian groups: every global section of $\underline E$ is the constant section of a unique $e\in E$.

source.place: Stacks Project, Etale Cohomology, Remark (Tag 03P5, label etale-cohomology-remark-constant-locally-constant-maps): on the small etale site the sheafification of the constant presheaf with value a group G has Gamma(U, G) = the Zariski locally constant maps U -> G (the Zariski sheafification is representable by the constant group scheme G_S, Groupoids Example Tag 03YW, and representable presheaves are etale (fpqc) sheaves, Lemma Tag 03O3); a locally constant map on a connected space is constant
